title: Unified Logistics Support Orchestration
business: Global logistics providers managing high-volume, multi-channel shipment inquiries.
problem: Support teams struggle with fragmented customer context across SMS, email, and voice, leading to repetitive data entry and inconsistent resolution times for complex shipment tracking issues.
solution: Sierra enables the deployment of a single, unified AI agent that maintains persistent customer context across all channels, allowing the agent to reference historical shipment data and long-horizon planning to resolve multi-step logistics queries without human intervention.
steps: Upload existing SOPs and historical support transcripts into the Sierra Ghostwriter to establish the agent's core knowledge base.
Configure the agent to integrate with internal logistics systems to enable real-time shipment status lookups.
Define guardrails within the Sierra platform to ensure agent responses align with company communication standards.
Deploy the unified agent across SMS, email, and voice channels to centralize customer interactions.
Utilize the Insights Explorer to monitor agent performance and refine conversation design based on actual interaction data.
outcome: A seamless, personalized support experience where customers receive consistent, context-aware updates regardless of the channel they choose to contact.
limitation: The agent's reliance on uploaded SOPs and system integrations means that if the underlying logistics data is outdated or incomplete, the agent may provide inaccurate status updates; this can be checked by reviewing the Observability logs for tool call outputs.

questions.question: In Unified Logistics Support Orchestration, what is the primary benefit of using a single Sierra agent across channels?

It forces customers to use only one specific communication channel.

questions.question: In Unified Logistics Support Orchestration, how can a user verify if the agent is providing inaccurate information due to stale data?

By manually deleting all historical support transcripts.
By increasing the frequency of SMS notifications.
By disabling the Insights Explorer monitoring tool.
